test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Vijendra walks a certain distance, say X metres, from his home towards the west. Then he turns left and walks 23 metres. After that, he turns left and walks 36 metres. Then he turns left again to walk 23 metres. He finally turns left and walks 18 metres to reach his home. Find the value of X.
solution:
**Given:**

1) Vijendra walks a certain distance, say X metres, from his home towards the west.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0794b723bff779ba9c236c2490eb03a8dcc611cfe852597bc4da8a34e8120586.png] 

2) Then he turns left and walks 23 metres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59835e556dedbc60efeddc38cbe32a78e636d9086914796e0d454d8f59858e0b.png] 

3) After that, he turns left and walks 36 metres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8109551d3ae26226495e8ced6629424e01413a156f4f076a83d437d8815af9f3.png] 

4) Then he turns left again to walk 23 metres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d2785ea5aa0d23e97b4ab88026d219840d537714e6bd739c2578bd3a7d72787.png] 

5) He finally turns left and walks 18 metres to reach his home.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05b4599bbac99b03e613a421290f846cd12ef82b40b20b127e025d6a23b63b6c.png] 

Final figure according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05b4599bbac99b03e613a421290f846cd12ef82b40b20b127e025d6a23b63b6c.png] 

⇒ BC - ED = 36 - 18 = **18 m** 

Hence, the correct answer is **"18".**
